citations.narrative:
The facility exceeded the maximum number of animals authorized under its USDA license. The USDA Class A Breeder
Certificate authorizes a maximum inventory of 900 animals. The count during inspection was 1,565 birds.
Operating with a greater number of animals than authorized under the license may impede USDA Officials’ ability to
effectively evaluate and oversee licensing activities and ensure facilities are operating within the scope of their approved
licensing authorization.
The facility must operate within the limits authorized by its USDA license. Either decrease the number of animals on hand
or apply for a new license that allows for a greater number of birds. To be corrected by August 10, 2026.

The facility failed to maintain a primary enclosure that securely contained the birds. During the inspection, a green-
cheeked parakeet fledgling housed by the facility was observed outside of its primary enclosure and clinging to the
exterior back wall of the enclosure. There was no observable damage or defects noted on the enclosure and facility
representatives stated that the bird likely escaped during feeding. The bird was recaptured and returned to the enclosure.
Birds that are not securely contained may be unable to readily access food and water, and may be more vulnerable to
injury, predation, or environmental hazards.
Primary enclosures must be constructed and maintained so that they securely contain the birds. To be corrected from this
day, July 10, 2026, forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
